_doc: The symbol of each main ingredient category (data/constraints/categories.json) in the ingredient galaxy: a small still life of three typical things, drawn with the ingredient symbol prompt (services/ingredient_symbols.category_symbol) and kept in concept_visual (concept_type ingredient_category). Made with scripts/category_symbols.py. A sub category has no own image: it shows the symbol of its most used ingredient (routes/explore_routes.py).
form: Show the three side by side and slightly overlapping, as one small group, all the same size, nothing else. No circle, frame, border or badge around them: they stand free on the white background.

looks.alcoholic beverages: a dark wine bottle, a brown beer bottle and a small glass of clear spirit
looks.bakery and bread: a round loaf of bread, a baguette and a folded flatbread
looks.baking ingredients: a small open paper bag of white flour, a small heap of white sugar and a block of fresh yeast
looks.canned and preserved: two plain metal tins without labels and a glass jar of pickled cucumbers
looks.cereal grains and pasta: a small heap of white rice, a bundle of dry spaghetti and a few dry penne
looks.dairy and egg: a glass of milk, a wedge of yellow cheese and two brown eggs
looks.fats and oils: a glass bottle of golden oil and a block of butter
looks.fish and seafood: a whole raw fish, a raw salmon fillet and two pink shrimps
looks.fruit and fruit products: a red apple, a yellow banana and a small bunch of green grapes
looks.meat: a raw steak, a raw chicken drumstick and a raw sausage
looks.non-alcoholic beverages: a glass of orange juice, a cup of black coffee and a glass of water
looks.nuts and seeds: three small heaps: almonds, walnuts and sunflower seeds
looks.sauces and condiments: a small glass jar of red tomato sauce, a jar of yellow mustard and a small bottle of soy sauce
looks.spices and herbs: three small heaps of ground spices in red, yellow and brown, with a sprig of fresh green herb
looks.vegetables: a carrot with its green top, a red tomato and a leek, lying side by side
looks.other: a small heap of mixed dried foods: a few beans, a few grains and a few seeds
